Local Taylor with A=ρ√(1+m²), B=ρg"/[2√(1+m²)] gives polynomial swallowtail normal form; transverse crossing and cusp zeros are secured by IFT. Exact Green integral gives 8√3 A^(7/2)/(35B^(3/2)) per loop. Ellipse g minima and q formula symbolically reconstructed; independent numerical double-point integration converges to radical coefficient for aspect ratios 1.5, 2 and 3; fixed-area derivative has only critical m²=3/7 and positive endpoints. Limits: no uniform near-circle claim and all mathematical assumptions explicit.

value.rationale: Quantifies the actual Euclidean area enclosed by microscopic loops at a natural first loss of evolutoid convexity, instead of simply observing their already-known swallowtail topology. The exact coefficient is controlled by curvature radius and second derivative of logarithmic curvature-radius slope, and for ellipses yields a unique area-normalized minimizer across every noncircular aspect ratio. This nontrivial sharp shape optimum and a metric singularity coefficient are geometrically motivated diagnostics; the inherited A3 exponent/critical angle are explicitly not novelty claims.
